lines.text: How far ahead do you signal?

lines.text: Headlights, low beams in bad weather
Horn: light tap, never near blind walkers
Signal one hundred feet ahead, then cancel

narration.text: To close, headlights help others see you, especially in rain, snow or fog, when you use low beams and slow down, and at dusk or with a low sun behind you. A light horn tap warns pedestrians, cyclists and inattentive drivers, but use the horn only to communicate and never near blind pedestrians.
